text: Completed the current-version GazeWeave sweep after refreshing eyesim from GitHub to 8600ac6428f9c0864c114bdbd8f0244e2fc631d1. Full results and source provenance are preserved with verified hashes under the gitignored fixtures/private/pic_sequences/runs/20261013-gazeweave-sweep/; interpretation.json records the conclusions and limitations. Next useful validation is fitted contraction plus full-reference density through eyes4s, with GazeWeave full-reference comparison remaining a separate follow-up. No eyes4s GazeWeave or Studio replication claim. G2 remains open for the broader library/application and timing-provenance work.
